tournaments._comment: Tournament placements keyed by tournament ID (matches docs/data/tournaments/tournaments.json). 'placements' is an ordered list of beys by finishing position (index 0 = 1st). 'participants' overrides the player count from tournaments.json when set to a positive integer. Optional 'date' (YYYY-MM-DD) ensures the XP is applied at the correct point in the chronological timeline.

season_end_placements._comment: End-of-season XP bonuses. Each key is a season ID matching SeasonID in matches.csv. 'date' (YYYY-MM-DD) must be the last day of the season so XP is applied after all season matches. 'placements' is an ordered list of beys by final standing (index 0 = 1st).
